name: bus-arrivals-board
title: Bus Arrivals Board
description: Bus stop departures as a flat time-ordered list, with optional route grouping — pass RealtimePrediction[] as data.

files.content:
/**
 * Stable natural route order for grouped bus boards (9 before 18 before 205).
 */

export const compareBusRouteNames = (a: string, b: string): number =>
  a.localeCompare(b, "en", { numeric: true, sensitivity: "base" })
